Which of the following is notnecessary when using a measuring cylinder to measure the volume
of a quantity of water?
A
making sure that the measuring cylinder is vertical
B
making sure that your eye is level with the liquid surface
C
reading the bottom of the meniscus
D
using the largest measuring cylinder possible

options.label: A
options.text: making sure that the measuring cylinder is vertical

options.label: B
options.text: making sure that your eye is level with the liquid surface

options.label: C
options.text: reading the bottom of the meniscus

options.label: D
options.text: using the largest measuring cylinder possible
